done_when: forge decision accept on a sign-off decision with no approval details yet runs the strict sign-off review and stops without accepting, saying the review passed and the sign-off email can go out (or naming the gaps); with the reply recorded, it accepts as today; tests run both through forge decision accept

findings.body: The new instructions say to run `forge decision accept` before and after the reply, but that command requires a slug and `--by` (src/forge/records.py:505-509). Following the guide literally stops at argument parsing, before either review or acceptance. Show the complete command for both steps.
findings.title: Show a runnable sign-off command in the guide

findings.body: The new return skips the existing `supersedes` validation at src/forge/records.py:296-300. With blank approval fields and a nonexistent `supersedes` target, Forge reports that the review passed and the customer can be asked, but refuses the same decision after the reply is recorded. Check this decision-record gap before the review-only success message.
findings.title: Validate supersedes before advising the operator to request sign-off

why: The sign-off review runs only when the customer's reply is recorded, so the customer is asked to approve a version that hasn't passed review
